basic_details.job_title: AP Prisons Full-Time Social Counsellor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Government of Andhra Pradesh, Prisons Department (Jailla Shakha), has invited applications from male candidates for one (01) post of Full-Time Social Counsellor at Central Prison, Nellore. The engagement is on contract basis for one year, with a consolidated remuneration of Rs.30,000/- per month. Applications in the prescribed Bio-data form go by post or in person to the Deputy Inspector General of Prisons, Guntur Range, Mangalagiri. Applications must reach the office on or before 31 October 2026. Applications received after that date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About AP Prisons Full-Time Social Counsellor
content_sections.text: The Deputy Inspector General of Prisons, Guntur Range, Mangalagiri, issued this notification on 12 October 2026. It is based on G.O.Rt.No.676, Home (Prisons & Fire) Department, dated 27 May 2026. The Director General of Prisons and Correctional Services, Andhra Pradesh, Mangalagiri, communicated that order through Memo No.Estt.5/220/2015, dated 14 August 2026. The counsellor will be engaged at Central Prison, Nellore.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their application in the prescribed Bio-data form . The form must contain complete details and must be sent with the necessary attested documents. Applications can be submitted either by post or in person to this address: The Deputy Inspector General of Prisons, Guntur Range, D.No. 11-565/102, Tiruveedula Enclave, Near Kondapaneni Township, Chellapalli Junction, NH16 Service Road, Tenali Flyover Junction, Mangalagiri, Guntur District – AP – 522503 The application must reach this office on or before 31 October 2026. The notice does not mention the wording to write on the envelope or a particular postal service. It also does not say where the Bio-data form can be obtained. For further information or clarification, candidates may call mobile number 80082 29604 or contact the office. Further information is also available on the official website, prisons.ap.gov.in. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Full-Time Social Counsellor at Central Prison, Nellore. Only male candidates are invited to apply. The candidate shall possess all of the following: Master's Degree in Psychology PG Diploma in Counselling A minimum of 3 years of experience in counselling Ability to work on computers and proficiency in using MS Office packages The notification lists these counselling skills: Positive regard / respect for the client Empathic and caring Self aware and culturally sensitive Good listener and maintain confidentiality Clear in communication Non-Judgmental and accepting attitude Ethics The selected candidate will be paid a consolidated remuneration of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) per month. The engagement is purely on contract basis for a period of one year. The engagement is subject to the terms and conditions prescribed by the competent authority. Preference will be given to local candidates. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AP Prisons Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Full-Time Social Counsellor, at Central Prison, Nellore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AP Prisons Social Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Deputy Inspector General of Prisons, Guntur Range, Mangalagiri, on or before 31 October 2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Full-Time Social Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Psychology and a PG Diploma in Counselling. They also need a minimum of 3 years of experience in counselling, plus the ability to work on computers and proficiency in MS Office packages.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the AP Prisons Social Counsellor?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will get a consolidated remuneration of Rs.30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the AP Prisons Full-Time Social Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed Bio-data form with complete details and attach the necessary attested documents. Submit it by post or in person to the Deputy Inspector General of Prisons, Guntur Range, Mangalagiri, so that it reaches the office by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the AP Prisons Social Counsellor post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contract basis for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q7. Can women apply for the AP Prisons Social Counsellor post?
faq.answer: No. The notification invites applications from male candidates only.

faq.question: Q8. Do local candidates get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification states that preference will be given to local candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact for details about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates may call mobile number 80082 29604 or contact the office of the Deputy Inspector General of Prisons, Guntur Range, Mangalagiri. Further information is also available on prisons.ap.gov.in.
